title: VoteRecord
description: One agent's vote toward resolving a conflict-record by quorum instead of single-arbiter fiat, for cases .claude/rules/agent-orchestration.md's Arbiter role wants backed by an explicit count rather than one agent's say-so. Consumer/producer: lib/quorum.mjs (castVote writes, tallyVotes/resolveByQuorum read); resolveByQuorum closes the conflict-record and writes a decision-record once a choice crosses the configured threshold of the conflict's parties.
